Totally—here are the main paths in simple terms:
Candles: Melt wax, add fragrance, pour into a vessel, and let it cure. Great if you want cozy home vibes and gifts.
Soap: Mix a soap base with fragrance/color/add-ins, pour into a mold, and let it set. Fast results and lots of creativity.
Perfume/Room Spray: Blend fragrance into a base and bottle it. Quickest to make and easiest to test lots of scents.
